question: An Enterprise organisation wants a shorter data retention window applied to its chats and projects. Who is able to make that change?
options: A) Someone holding the Primary Owner or the Owner role, in the organisation's settings.
B) Any member of the organisation, from the privacy settings page of their own account.
C) Only Anthropic support staff, acting on a written request from the organisation's legal team.
D) The person who created each individual project, applied to that one project only.
correct_answers: A) Someone holding the Primary Owner or the Owner role, in the organisation's settings.
explanations: Correct. Custom retention controls are restricted to the Primary Owner or an Owner.
Individual members cannot set organisation-level retention.
The control is self-service for the appropriate owner roles.
Retention is an organisation-level control, not a per-project setting.
